about: Episodic search eval. Each query is asked the way the owner would ask it; a hit is any result from a conversation whose assistant text contains `marker` (and whose project contains `project`, when set). Markers were chosen to name 1-12 conversations on 2026-11-26. `kind`: semantic = the query avoids the marker; keyword = the query names an id.
